plan.notes: Official University of Arkansas 2026-27 undergraduate catalog, B.S. in Biology Eight-Semester Degree Plan. Semester totals: 15/15/15/15/16/15/15/14 = 120 units (matches catalog 'Total Units in Sequence: 120'). Variable-credit slots recorded at values matching the catalog year totals (MATH choice at 3, gen-ed fillers as shown). BIOL electives requirement: at least 18 hours of BIOL 30000+ courses with at least 12 hours at the 40000 level. Footnote 2 (additional BIOL elective rules) is truncated on the catalog page; students must consult the biology department for full rules.
